summary: EIP-8141 再提交四项修改：lightclient 把 frame 的 `gas_limit` 拆成 `execution_gas_limit` 和 `state_gas_limit`；AnkushinDaniil 在验证前缀中禁用 SLOTNUM，并说明 frame 收据没有交易级状态，起因是 Nethermind 与 ethrex 在同一笔交易的 JSON-RPC `status` 上一个报 `0x1`、一个报 `0x0`。EIP-8250 和 EIP-8272 的系统地址分别固定为以 8250、8272 结尾。trent_vanepps 解读 Glamsterdam 包含的 10 个 EIP。

items.topic: EIP-8141 的 gas 维度与验证规则
items.title: EIP-8141：为 frame 加入显式的状态 gas 第二维度
items.note: （lightclient）提交：把 frame 的 `gas_limit` 拆为 `execution_gas_limit` 和 `state_gas_limit`，执行 gas 大体仍是调用帧层面的概念，状态 gas 则作为 frame 层面的概念，用来理清 frame 与 EIP-2780、7623、7708、7825、8037 之间剩余的边界情况。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: add an explicit second dimension for state gas to frames
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted: a frame's `gas_limit` splits into `execution_gas_limit` and `state_gas_limit`; execution gas stays (generally) a call-frame-level concept while state gas is a frame-level concept, to clear up the remaining edge cases between frames and EIP-2780, 7623, 7708, 7825 and 8037.
items.topic_en: Gas dimensions and validation rules in EIP-8141

items.topic: EIP-8141 的 gas 维度与验证规则
items.title: EIP-8141：在验证前缀执行中禁用 SLOTNUM
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交：验证前缀已禁止 `TIMESTAMP`、`NUMBER`、`PREVRANDAO`、`BASEFEE`、`BLOBBASEFEE` 等在接纳与打包之间会变化的操作码，否则交易可能在接纳时通过模拟、打包时回滚；EIP-7843 的 `SLOTNUM`（`0x4B`）具有同样性质。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: ban SLOTNUM during validation-prefix execution
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted: the validation prefix already bans opcodes whose value changes between admission and inclusion, such as `TIMESTAMP`, `NUMBER`, `PREVRANDAO`, `BASEFEE` and `BLOBBASEFEE`, since otherwise a transaction could pass simulation at admission and revert on inclusion; EIP-7843's `SLOTNUM` (`0x4B`) has the same property.
items.topic_en: Gas dimensions and validation rules in EIP-8141

items.topic: EIP-8141 的 gas 维度与验证规则
items.title: EIP-8141：说明 frame 收据不含交易级状态
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交：`ReceiptPayload` 没有交易级状态字段，但 JSON-RPC 收据有 `status`；在 Nethermind/ethrex devnet 上，同一笔 SENDER frame 回滚的交易被一个客户端报为 `0x1`、另一个报为 `0x0`，而所有共识字段一致。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: note that a frame receipt carries no transaction-level status
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted: `ReceiptPayload` has no transaction-level status field, but JSON-RPC receipts have `status`; on a Nethermind/ethrex devnet, the same transaction with a reverting SENDER frame was reported as `0x1` by one client and `0x0` by the other, while all consensus fields matched.
items.topic_en: Gas dimensions and validation rules in EIP-8141

items.topic: EIP-8141 的 gas 维度与验证规则
items.title: EIP-8250：NONCE_MANAGER 固定为 0x…8250
items.note: 与 EIP-8272：RECENT_ROOT_ADDRESS 固定为 0x…8272（AnkushinDaniil）提交，两个已知实现都独立选择了等于 EIP 编号的地址，与 8141 的 `EXPIRY_VERIFIER = 0x…8141` 惯例一致。
items.note_en: And EIP-8272: pin RECENT_ROOT_ADDRESS to 0x…8272 (AnkushinDaniil), submitted; both known implementations independently chose the address equal to the EIP number, matching 8141's `EXPIRY_VERIFIER = 0x…8141` convention.
items.topic_en: Gas dimensions and validation rules in EIP-8141

items.note: EIP-8250：NONCE_MANAGER 固定为 0x…8250 与 EIP-8272：RECENT_ROOT_ADDRESS 固定为 0x…8272（AnkushinDaniil）提交，两个已知实现都独立选择了等于 EIP 编号的地址，与 8141 的 `EXPIRY_VERIFIER = 0x…8141` 惯例一致。
items.note_en: EIP-8250: pin NONCE_MANAGER to 0x…8250 and EIP-8272: pin RECENT_ROOT_ADDRESS to 0x…8272 (AnkushinDaniil), submitted; both known implementations independently chose the address equal to the EIP number, matching 8141's `EXPIRY_VERIFIER = 0x…8141` convention.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 frames split execution gas and state gas
frame receipts carry no transaction-level status
summary_en: Four more EIP-8141 changes were submitted: lightclient split a frame's `gas_limit` into `execution_gas_limit` and `state_gas_limit`; AnkushinDaniil banned SLOTNUM in validation prefixes and noted that frame receipts carry no transaction-level status, after Nethermind and ethrex reported `0x1` and `0x0` respectively for the JSON-RPC `status` of the same transaction. The system addresses of EIP-8250 and EIP-8272 were pinned to addresses ending in 8250 and 8272. trent_vanepps explained the 10 EIPs in Glamsterdam.
